ACCESS: direct curl_cffi with profile rotation (chrome124/chrome131/safari17_2_ios/safari18_0/firefox133 all returned 200); plain curl is Akamai-403 on this host, exactly as the Furniture pass recorded. No proxy, no reader service, no browser automation. robots.txt was fetched FIRST: a single 'User-Agent: *' group that Disallows only /checkout/ and /confirmation/ and Allows /.well-known/; it names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent and declares NO Crawl-delay. probe.py's 2s per-host gap was applied throughout anyway. TREE: reconciled from three independent sources. (1) https://www.habitat.co.uk/sitemap.xml -> main_sitemap.xml, 1,235 locs of which 1,150 are /c:/ category nodes; grepped for bath|bathroom|shower|toilet|basin|tap|mirror|sanitary|towel|wc|vanity. (2) The mega-menu taxonomy in window.__HABITAT_INITIAL_PROPS__.taxonomy, present on every page - 11 top-level departments (Garden, Furniture, Storage, Sofas & armchairs, Habitat Kids, Home furnishings, Lighting, Bedding, Cooking & dining, Electricals, Laundry & utility). Habitat has NO top-level Bathroom department; instead the word 'Bathroom' appears as a column HEADER (a title with an empty link) inside two mega-menus: Furniture > Bathroom > Bathroom storage, and Home furnishings > Bathroom > {Bath towels & mats, Bathroom accessories}. Those headers carry no URL of their own, which is why the top 'Bathroom' row here is a grouping row. (3) The child link lists rendered on the two parent PLPs, which is how the two nodes MISSING from the sitemap were found: bathroom-accessories/baskets-and-boxes c:809227 and bathroom-accessories/laundry-baskets c:827785, plus the second bathroom-mirrors id c:809232. QTY: the listing page's own rendered header, N products, cross-checked on every leaf against the "numberOfItems" value in the same served HTML - the two agreed on all 11 leaves and all 6 review nodes. No count was taken from a parent, a facet page or a pagination inference. Both parents are therefore recorded as grouping rows with blank qty/URL per rules 24 and 38. and its breadcrumbData.currentPageName matched the node requested, so no URL silently served a parent listing.
